extracted.intended_audience: authors preparing and submitting manuscripts to the Annals of Probability (probability/math researchers submitting to an IMS journal)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and requirements for preparing and electronically submitting a manuscript to the Annals of Probability, and for providing source files and handling proof corrections after acceptance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality and concurrent submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission of a manuscript implies (a) that the same work has not been published before; (b) that it is not under consideration for publication elsewhere; and (c) that its publication has been approved by all co-authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic submission via EJMS
rubrics_metrics.description: Papers must be submitted electronically. Authors should access the Electronic Journal Management System (EJMS) at https://www.e-publications.org/ims/submission/. If you are a first time user you must complete the registration. You are only required to register once.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After the registration is complete you will have the option to submit your manuscript. After completing the form you will then upload your PDF file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission file format for initial upload
rubrics_metrics.description: Initial manuscript upload is a PDF file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the EJMS submission form and then upload your PDF file as part of the submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission of Reference Papers / Supplementary material
rubrics_metrics.description: Unpublished or not easily available papers cited in the manuscript should be submitted with the manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This information may be sent as supplementary files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript formatting — AOP template requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Manuscripts should be submitted in a format compatible with the AOP template: the text box is 126.53×193.31 mm (4.98×7.61 in) and the font in the template is CRM10 11pt.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the detailed 'Preparation of Manuscripts' instructions (linked from the page) for full formatting requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of source files after acceptance
rubrics_metrics.description: After a paper is accepted, you will be asked to provide Mattson Publishing Services and the Production Editor with a LaTeX file of the final version of the paper, if one is available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Other forms of TeX are acceptable if LaTeX is not available. You will also be asked to supply source files for figures (.eps or .jpg are preferred) along with a PDF file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Figure source file preferences
rubrics_metrics.description: Preferred figure source file formats are .eps or .jpg.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply source files for figures along with the LaTeX (or other TeX) source and PDF when requested after acceptance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Galley proofs and corrections process
rubrics_metrics.description: The corresponding author will receive email regarding galley proofs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The email will include instructions for returning corrections as well as links to forms required for publication.
